output.sql: SELECT p.method, ROUND(AVG(p.paid_at - o.order_date), 2) AS avg_days_to_pay FROM marts.fct_payments AS p JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY p.method ORDER BY p.method
output.explanation: Average days from order date to payment arrival (paid_at - order_date) for each payment method. It covers all recorded payments, including those for returned orders, which were paid and later refunded.
